subject: Priority req: temporary offer hold + headcount exemption request
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: liz@acmehr.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Priority req: temporary offer hold + headcount exemption request

Hi Liz / team,

Quick context: the Senior Search Engineer req (Req-1234) is a direct revenue-enabling hire tied to the Acme Analytics pilot (go-live in Q4). We have an offer out to Emma Jensen and the candidate is ready to sign, but leadership just announced the temporary hiring pause across non-critical reqs.

I need to request an exemption to: 1) allow the current offer to proceed, and 2) reallocate one backend engineer headcount from an unfilled latency team req (Req-1187) to this role if approval for the exemption is granted.

Key asks:
- HR: can you hold the candidate offer for 24 hours while we process the exemption? We may send a conditional offer letter (attached draft) that includes the pause caveat if needed.
- Finance: can we temporarily move one FTE from Req-1187 to Req-1234 within my org budget pending formal approval? That keeps us within the same band spend but prioritizes revenue-critical work.

I copied Vivek and Lauren for approval routing (Vivek on headcount, Lauren on org priority). This role was scoped at band E (see attached comp band reference).

Thanks,
Grace

--
Grace O'Connor
Director, Core Product
Redwood Inference
From: Liz Martin <liz@acmehr.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Priority req: temporary offer hold + headcount exemption request

Thanks Grace — understood.

We can pause formal signings for 24 hours. I'll notify Emma that we're finalizing internal approvals and share a conditional offer window. If you decide to send the conditional offer, include clear language that employment start is contingent on final headcount approval.

I attached a redlined offer template (offer_emma_jensen_draft_v2.pdf) and flagged comp band E. If you want me to hold any signature links (DocuSign), say the word.

Cheers,
Liz

--
Liz Martin
Senior Recruiter, Acme Talent Partners
Attachment: offer_emma_jensen_draft_v2.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>

Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Priority req: temporary offer hold + headcount exemption request

Grace — I support prioritizing revenue-impacting hires, but we need finance sign-off before any permanent reallocation. For a temporary exemption (24–72h) to let the candidate sign and start onboarding, I can greenlight org-priority.

Please include:
- A one-paragraph justification for the Exceptions Committee (what happens if we do NOT hire)
- Confirmation this role cannot be backfilled by contractors in the next quarter
- The proposed fallback if the exemption is denied (e.g., keep candidate on hold and reopen Req-1187)

I'll queue this for the weekly exceptions review but looping Vivek is the right call for budget impact.

-Lauren

VP, People Operations
Redwood Inference

Following up after a quick sync with Finance (cc'd). Finance is OK with a temporary reallocation as long as:
- Total run-rate impact stays within current Q3 headcount budget allocation for Core Product (no incremental spend).
- We document the swap in HRTicket-7890 and revert by EOW if Exceptions Committee denies it.

I approved a conditional transfer of one FTE from Req-1187 to Req-1234 for up to 30 days. Please route the formal note to Exceptions with the justification Lauren asked for.

Vivek
